result.title: Multi-Objective Generative Optimization via Expected Hypervolume Fine-Tuning
result.summary: Scientific discovery requires plausible designs spanning useful trade-offs among competing properties: a molecule with strong binding affinity, for example, may be difficult to synthesize. Pretrained generative models, e.g., flow and diffusion generators, provide a foundation for proposing such designs, but steering them toward high-quality, complementary trade-offs remains challenging. Inference-time search incurs high per-sample costs, while fine-tuning typically relies on fixed per-candidate rewards that do not capture how designs complement one another. We introduce Hypervolume Fine-Tuning (HVFT), which adapts a single pretrained generator to maximize the expected hypervolume of its samples while controlling departure from the pretrained distribution. Expected hypervolume jointly rewards candidate quality and collective trade-off coverage. Nonetheless, we show that it cannot be expressed as the expectation of a fixed per-candidate reward and therefore cannot be optimized directly with standard techniques. A key observation of this work is that its first variation corresponds to the expected marginal hypervolume contribution of a candidate, which yields a tractable adaptive reward via an unbiased estimator based on model samples. HVFT uses this reward to decompose the objective into a sequence of KL-proximal scalar-reward subproblems. We establish concavity, relative smoothness, and convergence guarantees for the resulting distributional procedure. Across therapeutic-peptide and molecular design tasks spanning discrete diffusion and continuous flow-matching models, HVFT achieves state-of-the-art expected hypervolume and trade-off coverage.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Hypervolume Fine-Tuning（HVFT）：把预训练扩散/流匹配生成器微调为最大化样本集合的期望超体积，以兼顾单样本质量与整体权衡覆盖；因该目标无法写成固定逐样本奖励的期望，作者利用其一阶变分等于候选的期望边际超体积贡献，从模型自身采样得到无偏自适应奖励，并把目标分解为一系列 KL 近端标量奖励子问题，给出凹性、相对光滑与收敛保证，在肽与分子设计任务上报告了最优超体积与覆盖度。
AI.relevance_reason: 「以边际贡献构造自适应奖励」与 KL 近端分解，可能为 LVR 中多条 latent 轨迹的集合级奖励与贡献分配、以及微调时对预训练分布的偏离约束提供可核查的训练监督线索。
